description:
Influencers Club connects ChatGPT to creator data across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Twitch, and OnlyFans. Ask in plain language — "find fitness creators on Instagram with 100k+ followers and 3%+ engagement" — and get back a ranked list you can act on.

The plugin provides 19 tools: creator discovery with semantic search and filters for followers, engagement, location, and language; profile enrichment including contact details, audience demographics, and past brand deals; recent posts with engagement metrics; audience-overlap comparison between creators; and lookalike search to find creators similar to one that already performs well.

Results come from the Influencers Club API and are billed against your account credits, appearing in your dashboard exactly as if you ran them there. Built for influencer marketers, agencies, talent managers, and founders doing campaign research, prospecting, and creator vetting.

defaultPrompt: Find 5 Instagram creators in fitness with 50k-500k followers and engagement above 3%
Get the full profile for cristiano on Instagram, including audience demographics
Find 10 YouTube creators similar to MrBeast
